Description.DefaultValue: Everyday Excel tools, a command palette, data cleaning and variance analysis. Runs on your device.

bt:String.DefaultValue: Add prefix or suffix to names...
Open the Cellwright tab. Every tool is in the ribbon menus and in the command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P).
Search every tool and sheet by name. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P.
Open the Cellwright pane with every tool, the cleaner and the activity log.
Put the workbook back the way it was before the last Cellwright tool ran.
Scan the current table, preview the fixes, then build a variance summary.
Adds an Index sheet that lists every sheet with a link to it.
Copies the table around the active cell to one new sheet per value of a column you choose, such as one sheet per region.
Fills each empty cell in the table with the value above it. Useful for exports where a group name appears only once.
Removes rows that repeat an earlier row exactly, comparing every column of the table.
Puts the sheet tabs in A to Z or Z to A order.
Makes every hidden and very hidden sheet visible.
Deletes sheets with no data, charts or shapes. Undo brings them back.
Stacks the tables on every visible sheet into one new sheet, matching columns by header and adding the source sheet name.
Adds the same text before or after every sheet name.
All 7 Sheets tools. Index, sort, unhide, split, combine and rename worksheets.
Deletes rows that are empty across the whole sheet. Works on the selected rows, or the whole sheet if one cell is selected.
Deletes columns that are empty across the whole sheet. Works on the selected columns, or the whole sheet if one cell is selected.
Turns a wide table (one column per month, say) into a long one with Attribute and Value columns, on a new sheet.
Copies the selection to a new sheet with rows and columns swapped.
Select two blocks of the same size (hold Ctrl for the second). Cells that differ are shaded in both.
Select two blocks of the same size (hold Ctrl for the second) and their contents trade places.
Flips the order of the selected rows, last row first.
Reports how many cells, blanks, distinct values and repeated values the selection has. Changes nothing.
All 10 Range tools. Fill, delete empty rows and columns, remove duplicates, unpivot, compare and swap.
Changes text in the selection to upper case. Formulas are left alone.
Changes text in the selection to lower case. Formulas are left alone.
Capitalises the first letter of each word, like Excel's PROPER function.
Lower case with a capital letter at the start of each sentence.
UPPER, lower, Proper or Sentence case for the selected text.
Removes leading and trailing spaces, double spaces and non-breaking spaces.
Splits one column into several at a comma, semicolon, space or other character. The columns to the right must be empty.
Replaces line breaks inside cells with a single space.
Removes digits, letters, punctuation, invisible characters or characters you type.
Strips everything except digits, for IDs and phone numbers. The result stays text so leading zeros are kept.
Adds the same text before or after every non-empty cell.
Joins each row of the selected columns into one text, written in the empty column to the right.
Replaces text that matches a regular expression. $1, $2 in the replacement insert captured groups.
All 12 Text tools. Case, spaces, characters, split, join, prefixes and regex replace.
Turns numbers stored as text into real numbers: 1,200, (300), 300-, 12%, SAR 3,000. Codes with leading zeros are left alone.
Turns text such as 14/03/2025, 2025-03-14 or 14 Mar 2025 into real dates. Each column's day/month order is detected.
Rounds numbers to a number of decimals. Formulas are wrapped in ROUND so they stay live.
Turns positives into negatives and the other way round.
Applies one calculation to every number, for example divide by 1,000 to show thousands.
Writes whole numbers as text of a fixed length, such as 42 to 000042, for site and employee IDs.
Sets one date format on every number in the selection.
All 7 Numbers & Dates tools. Convert text to numbers and dates, round, change sign, calculate and format.
Replaces formulas in the selection with their current results, including spilled arrays.
Wraps each formula in IFERROR with the fallback you choose. Formulas already wrapped are skipped.
Rewrites exact-match VLOOKUPs as XLOOKUP, which survives inserted columns. Lookups it cannot convert safely are left as they are.
Rewrites cell references in the selected formulas as absolute ($A$1), relative (A1) or mixed.
Lists formulas across all sheets that are volatile, broken, link to other files, use legacy lookups or nest many IFs.
All 5 Formulas tools. Convert to values, IFERROR, reference style, VLOOKUP to XLOOKUP and a workbook formula report.
Shades every other data row of the table. It is conditional formatting, so it stays correct after sorting.
Makes the table's first row bold and shaded with a line underneath.
Selects empty cells in the selection, or in the used range if one cell is selected.
Selects formulas that return an error.
Selects every cell that holds a formula.
Selects cells holding typed values rather than formulas.
Selects every cell whose value appears more than once in the selection.
Selects cells that equal, contain, start with or are greater or less than a value.
Selects only the visible cells, so filtered or hidden rows are skipped when you copy.
All 7 Select tools. Select blanks, errors, formulas, constants, duplicates, visible cells or cells matching a value.
Shows negative numbers in the selection in red.
Sets every used column on the sheet to fit its contents.
Freezes the rows down to the table's header so it stays visible when you scroll.
Removes fills, fonts, borders and number formats from the selection and keeps the values.
Unmerges merged cells and copies the value into every cell that was part of the merge.
All 7 Format tools. Banded rows, negatives in red, header style, autofit, freeze, clear and unmerge.
